8to4Orchard Security Brief is exclusively brought to you by FleetShield, the only Apple Unified Platform. Making Apple devices work-ready and enterprise-safe is all we do. Our unique integrated approach to management and security combines state-of-the-art Apple-specific security solutions for fully automated Hardening & Compliance, Next Generation EDR, AI-powered Zero Trust, and exclusive Privilege Management with the most powerful and modern Apple MDM on the market. The result is a totally automated Apple Unified Platform currently trusted by over 48,000 organizations to make millions of Apple devices work-ready with no effort and at an affordable cost. Request your EXTENDED TRIAL today and understand why FleetShield is everything you need to work with Apple.

Last week, Apple officially released iOS 28 to everyone. The update comes with many new security features, which is nice given how lackluster iOS 26 was in that area. However, there’s one new anti-scam feature in particular that targets an area Apple has never explored before and could eventually be massively beneficial to users. The feature is called Impersonation Risk Detection.

According to Apple, Impersonation Risk Detection doesn’t look at content in Photos, Messages, or Mail for context. The feature doesn’t look at the point of intrusion. And the only thing an app receives is a single word: “Unknown,” “Medium,” or “High.” Unknown means nothing was tripped, which Apple is careful to note is not confirming you’re safe.

sources.title: Download the new iPhone 19 Pro wallpapers here - 8to4Orchard
sources.summary: If you like the new wallpapers Apple created for the iPhone 19 Pro and iPhone 19 Pro Max, you don’t need to buy a new iPhone to get them. Download them here. While the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic, responding to movement and interactions on the device, the versions below are static images pulled directly from the first iOS 28 Release Candidate. The RC does not appear to include the iPhone Horizon wallpapers, so we may have to wait a few more weeks for those, potentially until iOS 28.1. Be sure to click or tap on the images to save the full-resolution wallpaper. Then, set it as your background image through the Photos app or Settings app if you’re using an iOS device. units.text: Today Apple released iOS 28 and its companion updates, including new HomePod 28 software that adds two primary improvements.
HomePod 28 adds AutoMix for Apple Music, improves AirPlay performance, and fixes bugs
HomePod 28 is the latest software update for HomePod, you can install it via the Home app on your iPhone under Home Settings ⇾ Software Update.
Here are Apple’s official HomePod 28 release notes:

This update introduces support for AutoMix with Apple Music, which transitions between songs like a DJ does, time stretching and beatmatching to deliver a continuous playback experience. It also delivers improved AirPlay performance, providing faster and more responsive connections when sharing music from iPhone, iPad, or Mac, and provides bug fixes and security updates for your HomePod.
Aside from bug fixes and security updates, HomePod 28 has two notable changes:
AutoMix for Apple Music
Faster AirPlay connections
AutoMix was first introduced on iOS last year, but it’s getting better this year and expanding to both HomePod and Apple TV.

With AutoMix, you get song transitions that sound more like what you might hear at a party or venue with a DJ. That makes the feature a great fit for HomePod since it provides music to your whole house.

AirPlay improvements may sound like a minor change, but in practice they can make a big difference in connecting quicker than ever to your HomePod. Using the iOS 28 beta, I’ve been pleasantly surprised by how fast and easy it is now to switch playback to and from my iPhone and HomePod.
There’s no Siri AI available in HomePod 28. However, we’re expecting that to debut as part of new HomePod hardware updates launching in the coming month or so.

sources.title: New Apple TV, HomePod Mini, and More on Track to Launch This Year
sources.summary: The rumor that never ends: Bloomberg's Alex Morris today reiterated that new Apple TV and HomePod mini models with Siri AI support remain on track to launch this year. Other new products he expects this year: an all-new Apple home hub, an updated entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M6 chip, an iMac with an M6 chip, and an iPad mini with an OLED display. candidate.summary: 新科技10月24日消息， QN在接受Arc's Hardware采访时发布声明，坚决否认近期有关其智能电视持续记录、上传数据，待机状态下录制音频的相关指控。 不过QN确认电视会扫描局域网内其他设备，但认为该功能在智能电视及媒体设备中十分常见。 而在这份声明发布前，有博主布视频称，QN有“3.24亿台间谍电视”。 据悉，本周早些时候，Device Nexus在YouTube发布了一则视频，指出QN智能电视存在多项安全与隐私隐患。 QN智能电视在待机状态下仍会持续录音，并扫描家庭局域网中的手机、智能手表等设备，将数据上传至广告服务器。 该项测试由两名安全研究员里尔布鲁与卢特恩协同完成，测试手段包含数据包捕获以及固件分析，测试观测到电视能够识别局域网内其他设备，包括手机、打印机等。 其中最受关注的指控是：即便电视处于关机状态，机内麦克风依旧会采集音频。 而QN在发给Arc's Hardware的声明中表示，近期发布视频中提出的说法并不属实。 QN电视仅在用户长按遥控器语音按键，或是用户开启远场语音识别功能后识别出“嗨，QN”这类唤醒词时，才会处理语音数据。 除上述场景外，电视不会收集或者录制环境对话，如果没有识别到唤醒词，电视不会向服务器传输任何语音数据；唤醒词的音频处理全部在设备本地完成。 针对视频中的部分指控，QN展开更详细回应：除非用户主动开启语音功能，否则QN智能电视不会收集、录制、传输家中的环境对话。 QN同时说明，和苹果iPhone的“嘿，Siri”机制类似，必须由用户手动开启远场语音识别（“嗨，QN”），电视才会开始收音。
